Sweepfield: Minesweeper Puzzle — Support

Sweepfield is a calm, botanical minesweeper with a worldwide daily challenge, guess-free boards, and full VoiceOver support.

FAQ

  • Is every board really solvable without guessing? Yes. Every board in every mode is verified by a solver before it is shown to you.
  • Is the daily board the same for everyone? Yes. All players worldwide receive the identical board each day (based on your local calendar date).
  • How do I remove ads? Home → Settings → Remove Ads (one-time purchase). Use "Restore Purchases" on a new device.
